Sofia, Kwame Adjei-Rowe owns Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Bettina said so in this channel on Oct 14, and nothing has changed since. Please send the ticket to Kwame.

"PHL" is also the short name for Pellow Home Living, which is your retail account. Bettina is covering Pellow this week while you're at Hagerstown. If the ticket is about the Gulf Coast terminal or container rows, it's Pellucid and goes to Kwame. If it's the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, it's Pellow. I can't see the ticket, so I'm going by the labels only.
